# WPPlugins — Full Reference for AI Agents & Automation

WPPlugins mirrors public WordPress.org plugins from Subversion (`https://plugins.svn.wordpress.org/<slug>/`) to individual GitHub repositories (`https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>`).

## 1. Repository & URL Conventions

| Resource | Pattern |
| :--- | :--- |
| GitHub Repository | `https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>` |
| Git Clone URL | `https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git` |
| Dedicated Web Page | `https://wpplugins.github.io/plugins/<slug>/` |
| Upstream WordPress.org Page | `https://wordpress.org/plugins/<slug>/` |
| Paginated Directory | `https://wpplugins.github.io/plugins/` (and `/plugins/page/<n>/`) |

## 2. Branch & Tag Semantics

- `main` (or `master` on older legacy mirrors) tracks WordPress.org SVN `trunk/`.
- Annotated Git tags match WordPress.org SVN `tags/<version>` and are sorted in SemVer order during sync.
- Commit messages include the upstream SVN revision and author when synced by `WPPlugins/mirror-orchestrator`.

## 3. Data Dump Schema (`/data/plugins.json`)

The index at `https://wpplugins.github.io/data/plugins.json` is rebuilt every 2 hours (`0 */2 * * *` UTC) and contains a JSON array sorted alphabetically by slug:

```json
[
  {
    "s": "akismet",
    "d": "The best anti-spam protection to block spam comments and spam in a contact form.",
    "p": "2026-11-26",
    "b": "main"
  }
]
```

- `s`: WordPress.org plugin slug (and GitHub repository name under `WPPlugins`).
- `d`: Short description (up to 200 characters).
- `p`: Last pushed date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `b`: Default branch (`main` or `master`).

## 4. Platform-Specific Recipes

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
git submodule add https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git wp-content/plugins/<slug>
git commit -m "chore: add <slug> plugin submodule"

# Pin to latest release tag:
Push-Location wp-content\plugins\<slug>
git fetch --tags; if ($?) { $tag = git describe --tags --abbrev=0; git checkout $tag }
Pop-Location
```

### macOS (zsh) / Linux (bash)
```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git wp-content/plugins/<slug> && \
  git commit -m "chore: add <slug> plugin submodule"

# Pin to latest release tag:
(cd wp-content/plugins/<slug> && git fetch --tags && git checkout "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)")
```

### Composer VCS
```json
{
  "repositories": [
    {
      "type": "vcs",
      "url": "https://github.com/WPPlugins/<slug>.git"
    }
  ]
}
```
Note: Many WordPress.org plugins do not ship a `composer.json`. For Composer dependency resolution, pair with WPackagist (`https://wpackagist.org/`) or define a `type: package` entry pointing to the desired tag/archive.

## 5. Limitations & Policies

- **Read-only mirrors:** Do not open issues or PRs on individual plugin mirror repositories; submit upstream fixes to the plugin authors on WordPress.org.
- **95 MB Blob Guardrail:** Files exceeding 95 MB in SVN are skipped during sync to comply with GitHub's 100 MB file limit. Skipped files are recorded in `https://github.com/WPPlugins/mirror-orchestrator/blob/main/state/oversized.json`.
- **Sync Issues & Priority Requests:** Open an issue in `https://github.com/WPPlugins/mirror-orchestrator/issues/new/choose`.
